anomalies.description: A large object (likely cargo or part of a vehicle) detaches from the rear of the white truck and impacts the road surface, scattering debris and causing visible sparks/flames upon impact.

A vehicle (likely a tanker or large truck) on the left lane is involved in a collision or loss of control, resulting in visible debris, sparks, and fire/ignition at the rear/side of the vehicle. The incident unfolds progressively from frame f2 (5.0s) onward, with clear evidence of impact and fire starting around f4 (6.0s) and continuing through f15 (11.5s).

A sudden bright flash and fireball erupts near the rear-left side of the white truck, consistent with an explosion (e.g., fuel tank ignition or secondary detonation), producing intense light and expanding fire.

A large vehicle (likely a truck) is involved in a crash, with debris and sparks flying upward and backward from the rear/right side of the vehicle; the load appears to be disintegrating or shedding material violently while still moving forward.

A second distinct impact or loss of control event occurs: a bright flash and violent upward ejection of debris/sparks reappears near the same vehicle, suggesting a secondary collision or structural failure after initial damage.

A vehicle (likely the camera car or a nearby vehicle) collides with or strikes an object on the right side of the road, producing a bright flash of orange/red light and debris/sparks visible in frames f0–f3. The impact appears sudden and violent, with visible distortion and motion blur consistent with a crash.

A second impact event occurs, indicated by a renewed burst of red/orange light and debris near the right lane edge in frames f5–f6, possibly from the same incident (e.g., secondary contact or fire flare-up) or a separate minor collision involving the same vehicle.
